heading: HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical & Home Generator Services in Fountain Inn, SC
intro: One licensed company covers Fountain Inn's heating, cooling, plumbing, electrical, and home generator needs, so a failed system and the panel feeding it get fixed on the same ticket. faqs.question: We just closed on a new build in Fountain Inn. What should we do first?
faqs.answer: Register the HVAC equipment warranty in your name, then schedule a first-year inspection. That visit verifies the builder's installation and starts the service record most manufacturer warranties require.

faqs.question: How do I know if my sewer line is the problem rather than a single drain?
faqs.answer: Watch the pattern. One slow fixture points to its own branch line, while multiple slow drains, gurgling, or backups at the lowest fixtures point to the main.

faqs.question: Can you run a gas line for a standby generator?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is one licensed company for the whole project. The plumbing side installs and pressure-tests the gas supply, the electrical side sets the generator and transfer switch.

faqs.question: Why does my new, tightly built house need a dehumidifier at all?
faqs.answer: Tight construction keeps conditioned air in, but it also keeps moisture from cooking, showers, and occupancy in with it. Dedicated dehumidification holds the range regardless.
